answer: Require every agent to lock a scarce, slashable stake before its votes or trades count. If it signs conflicting claims, anyone can prove the fraud and trigger a penalty. A sybil attacker must fund a bond for each identity, tying up capital and risking its loss; making more names is no longer free. A marble ledger records the bonds, while saffron marks flag suspicious clusters. The nadir: a wealthy attacker can still buy influence.
